acceptanceCriteria: action/validation/subagent/parallel/timeout/nonzero/missing/malformed paths covered

no hidden-gold/raw-text leakage

runs are VALID or explicitly INVALID

acceptanceCriteria: 16 paired runs classified
same provider/agent/model within pairs
